reason.zh: 流明是光通量单位，照度是单位受光面积上的光通量，单位为勒克斯。原现代题的50/50/10流明缺少受光面积或明确的测量解释，不能直接当成照度值。高度的逆平方模型还需要固定水平操作点、灯只在其正上方竖直移动、方向强度不变等条件。两项决定均未获得授权，故停止该题答案作者工作，不生成无条件答案或数值判题键。
reason.en: Lumens measure luminous flux; illuminance is flux per receiving area and is measured in lux. The modern task's 50/50/10 lumen claims lack receiving area or a defined measurement interpretation and cannot simply be treated as illuminance values. The inverse-square height model also needs a fixed horizontal workpoint, vertical lamp movement directly above it, and unchanged directional intensity. Neither decision is authorized, so answer authorship for this task stops without an unconditional answer or numeric grading key.

tasks.resolutionRequired: An authorized, source-bound unit/measurement decision and explicit physical model must precede a standard answer. No silent lm-to-lx repair, unit-area assumption, source erratum or change to the task is made.
